posts.caption:
Got a case study assignment? The most common mistake is retelling the story. Your marker already knows the case 📋

✅ Read the case twice, then read the brief and marking criteria
✅ Separate symptoms (falling sales) from causes (a slow supply chain) by asking "why?" several times
✅ Apply theories that fit, such as SWOT, Porter's Five Forces or Herzberg
✅ Compare two or three options on cost, risk and feasibility
✅ Recommend, then say who does what, by when, and how success is measured

posts.caption:
Writing a research proposal for a Master's dissertation or a PhD application? Each section should answer one question in a clear chain 🎓

1️⃣ Title: topic, context and population
2️⃣ Problem: the gap your study fills
3️⃣ Aim, objectives and research questions that line up
4️⃣ A short literature review, organised by theme
5️⃣ Method and a realistic timeline

Tip: write the problem statement and research questions first, even though they appear later in the document.

Free guide with an example and a checklist: fizbusinessolutions.com/blog/how-to-write-a-research-proposal

Data analysis help for your dissertation

Collected your survey responses or interview transcripts and not sure what to do next? FIZ Business Solutions (FIZBS) has supported university students in the UK and Saudi Arabia since 2015, and our Master's and PhD qualified experts work with SPSS, Excel, NVivo, Stata, Python and R.

Your expert explains each step so you understand and can discuss every result: cleaning and coding your dataset, choosing the right test, reading the output and writing up your findings.

What we cover: descriptive statistics, reliability testing, t-tests, ANOVA, chi-square, correlation and regression, thematic analysis of interviews and focus groups, and APA-style tables and charts.

We only work with data you have collected or legitimately obtained. We never create, alter or invent data or results.

Data analysis is priced by scope, so you get a clear quote before any work starts. New students get 10% off the first order, and you pay 50% to start and 50% on completion.
